messages:
kyle: Observed an ephemeral NVMe metadata burst in eu-west3-cohort-12 during a large container churn. Attach latency p95 doubled and a few binds timed out.
maria: Any node examples or quick logs?
kyle: gn-eu3-165 shows lots of tiny metadata writes: `metadata_ops=45000/s, smallwrite_ratio=0.87` and janitor kicked off compaction at same time. Kernel logged `ext4: orphan cleanup heavy` on 3 nodes.
raj: Sounds like metadata pressure + janitor compaction overlap. Mitigation: 1) temporarily set janitor compaction backoff for cohort-12, 2) avoid scheduling preemptible attaches to impacted nodes, 3) reroute attaches to warm pool in region for 15m.
dan: Ran a quick ops command: `ops-api patch cohort cohort-12 --janitor-backoff 900` and `opsctl tag gn-eu3-162 nvme:meta_hot=true`. Also added route to warm-pool with `opsctl route attach eu-west3 -> eu-west3-warm for 15m`.
infra-bot: ALERT: nvme_meta_burst detected cohort-12 nodes gn-eu3-160..gn-eu3-167. Attaches delayed: 6 in last 8m.
ops-sre: Confirmed plan. Please record cost delta if rerouting to warm pool; marginal cost ~+$0.6k/day if extended.
maria: After applying backoff and route, attach success improved from 72% -> 95% in 6m. We'll keep monitoring SMART and compaction metrics.
kyle: Action items: keep janitor backoff 15m, clear tags after cool down, follow up with infra-telemetry to add a meta_ops alert (threshold: meta_ops>30k for 5m).
ops-sre: Noted. Creating incident stub INF-1755553333.
kyle: TL;DR: metadata op burst + janitor compaction caused attach stalls; backoff janitor and reroute attaches to warm pool. Monitoring. :white_check_mark:
